title: Andryusha and Socks
statementMd:
Andryusha is an orderly boy and likes to keep things in their place.

Today he faced a problem to put his socks in the wardrobe. He has $*n*$ distinct pairs of socks which are initially in a bag. The pairs are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. Andryusha wants to put paired socks together and put them in the wardrobe. He takes the socks one by one from the bag, and for each sock he looks whether the pair of this sock has been already took out of the bag, or not. If not (that means the pair of this sock is still in the bag), he puts the current socks on the table in front of him. Otherwise, he puts both socks from the pair to the wardrobe.

Andryusha remembers the order in which he took the socks from the bag. Can you tell him what is the maximum number of socks that were on the table at the same time?

## Input

The first line contains the single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of sock pairs.

The second line contains $2*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{2*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), which describe the order in which Andryusha took the socks from the bag. More precisely, $*x*_{*i*}$ means that the $*i*$-th sock Andryusha took out was from pair $*x*_{*i*}$.

It is guaranteed that Andryusha took exactly two socks of each pair.

## Output

Print single integer — the maximum number of socks that were on the table at the same time.

## Note

In the first example Andryusha took a sock from the first pair and put it on the table. Then he took the next sock which is from the first pair as well, so he immediately puts both socks to the wardrobe. Thus, at most one sock was on the table at the same time.

In the second example Andryusha behaved as follows:

- Initially the table was empty, he took out a sock from pair $2$ and put it on the table.
- Sock $(2)$ was on the table. Andryusha took out a sock from pair $1$ and put it on the table.
- Socks $(1, 2)$ were on the table. Andryusha took out a sock from pair $1$, and put this pair into the wardrobe.
- Sock $(2)$ was on the table. Andryusha took out a sock from pair $3$ and put it on the table.
- Socks $(2, 3)$ were on the table. Andryusha took out a sock from pair $2$, and put this pair into the wardrobe.
- Sock $(3)$ was on the table. Andryusha took out a sock from pair $3$ and put this pair into the wardrobe.

Thus, at most two socks were on the table at the same time.
statementZhMd:
安德留沙是一个做事井井有条的男孩，喜欢把东西放在它们应该在的地方。

今天，他遇到了一个需要把袜子放进衣柜的问题。他有 $*n*$ 双不同的袜子，最初都放在一个袋子里。这些袜子对的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。安德留沙想把成对的袜子放在一起，然后将它们放进衣柜。他一个接一个地从袋子里取出袜子，并且对于每只袜子，都会查看它的另一只是否已经从袋子中取出。如果没有（也就是说，这只袜子的另一只仍在袋子里），他就把当前袜子放在面前的桌子上。否则，他就把这一对袜子都放进衣柜。

安德留沙记得自己从袋子里取出袜子的顺序。请你告诉他，同时放在桌上的袜子数量最多是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——袜子对的数量。

第二行包含 $2*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{2*n*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示安德留沙从袋子中取出袜子的顺序。更准确地说，$*x*_{*i*}$ 表示安德留沙取出的第 $*i*$ 只袜子属于第 $*x*_{*i*}$ 对袜子。

保证安德留沙恰好取出了每一对袜子中的两只。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——同时放在桌上的袜子数量的最大值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，安德留沙取出第一对袜子中的一只，并将它放在桌上。接着，他取出的下一只袜子也属于第一对，因此他立即将这两只袜子放进衣柜。于是，同时放在桌上的袜子数量最多为一只。

在第二个样例中，安德留沙的操作过程如下：

- 起初桌子是空的。他取出第 $2$ 对袜子中的一只，并将其放在桌上。
- 袜子 $(2)$ 在桌上。安德留沙取出第 $1$ 对袜子中的一只，并将其放在桌上。
- 袜子 $(1, 2)$ 在桌上。安德留沙取出第 $1$ 对袜子中的另一只，并将这一对袜子放进衣柜。
- 袜子 $(2)$ 在桌上。安德留沙取出第 $3$ 对袜子中的一只，并将其放在桌上。
- 袜子 $(2, 3)$ 在桌上。安德留沙取出第 $2$ 对袜子中的另一只，并将这一对袜子放进衣柜。
- 袜子 $(3)$ 在桌上。安德留沙取出第 $3$ 对袜子中的另一只，并将这一对袜子放进衣柜。

因此，同时放在桌上的袜子数量最多为两只。
